title: Antiproliferative evaluations of triazoloquinazolines as classical DNA intercalators: Design, synthesis, ADMET profile, and molecular docking.
authors: Eissa, Ibrahim H; Ibrahim, Mohamed-Kamal; Alesawy, Mohamed S; El-Adl, Khaled
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成三唑并喹唑啉类DNA嵌入剂并做抗增殖评价，含分子对接但对象为小分子-DNA嵌入而非TF-DNA互作，方法仅常规对接，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Novel triazoloquinazolines were designed and synthesized and evaluated as anticancer agents against HepG2 and HCT-116 cells. The biological testing data corresponded well to those of the molecular docking studies. The HCT-116 cell line was most affected due to the actions of our derivatives. Derivative 7(a) was the most potent one against both HepG2 and HCT116 cells, with IC(50)  = 7.98 and 5.57 microM, respectively. This compound showed anticancer activity that was nearly equipotent to that of doxorubicin against HepG2 cells, but higher than that of doxorubicin against HCT116 cells (IC(50)  = 7.94 and 8.07 microM, respectively). Compounds 8, 7(b) , and 6(f) showed excellent anticancer activities against both the HCT116 and HepG2 cell lines. The highly active compounds 6(f) , 7(a) , 7(b) , and 8 were evaluated for their DNA-binding activities. Compounds 7(a) and 8 showed the highest binding activities. These derivatives potently intercalate in DNA, at IC(50) values of 42.90 and 48.13 microM, respectively. Derivatives 6(f) and 7(b) showed good DNA-binding activities, with IC(50) values of 54.24 and 50.56 microM, respectively. Furthermore, in silico calculated ADMET profiles were established for our four highly active derivatives, in comparison to doxorubicin. Our derivatives 6(f) , 7(a) , 7(b) , and 8 showed a very good ADMET profile. Compounds 6(f) , 7(a) , 7(b) , and 8 follow Lipinski's rules, while doxorubicin violates three of these rules.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了新型三唑并喹唑啉类化合物，并评估了其对HepG2和HCT-116细胞的抗癌活性。生物学测试数据与分子对接研究结果高度一致。HCT-116细胞系受我们衍生物作用的影响最为显著。衍生物7(a)对HepG2和HCT116细胞均表现出最强的活性，其IC(50)值分别为7.98和5.57微摩尔。该化合物对HepG2细胞的抗癌活性几乎与多柔比星相当，但对HCT116细胞的活性高于多柔比星（IC(50)值分别为7.94和8.07微摩尔）。化合物8、7(b)和6(f)对HCT116和HepG2细胞系均显示出优异的抗癌活性。对高活性化合物6(f)、7(a)、7(b)和8进行了DNA结合活性评估。化合物7(a)和8表现出最高的结合活性，这些衍生物有效嵌入DNA，其IC(50)值分别为42.90和48.13微摩尔。衍生物6(f)和7(b)显示出良好的DNA结合活性，IC(50)值分别为54.24和50.56微摩尔。此外，针对我们的四种高活性衍生物，与多柔比星相比，建立了计算机模拟计算的ADMET谱图。我们的衍生物6(f)、7(a)、7(b)和8显示出非常好的ADMET谱图。化合物6(f)、7(a)、7(b)和8符合利平斯基规则，而多柔比星违反了其中三条规则。
